summary: 24-year-old solo hiker from Phoenix City, AL caught after dark near Sentinel Pass after hiking the Royal Arch, with no light to descend (~5:40 p.m. call); a City of Boulder OSMP ranger and RMRG members hiked to him and assisted him down to the trailhead; ~1.5-hr rescue (BCSO case 21-705).
responding_agency: Boulder County Sheriff's Office; City of Boulder Open Space and Mountain Parks; Rocky Mountain Rescue Group
